direction.camera: Guide attention with pop contrast; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: make one bold image crop collide with a short poster headline; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with halftone texture; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with graphic hit.
direction.lighting: high graphic contrast; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: screenprint ink and comic paper; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around bold crop; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use pop contrast,halftone texture,poster type,comic framing,bold crop,graphic hit as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
